bindings.source_summary: Minnesota pays residents to rip out their lawns and replace them with native wildflowers and pollinator habitat. Since 2019, nearly 10,000 projects have turned over 11 million square feet of ecologically barren turf into habitat across all 87 counties. Homeowners and renters can get up to $400 back. This is what it looks like when a state decides pollinators are actually worth protecting. Why isn't your state doing this?
